timing_note: Frozen after observing the cascade versus independent-ensemble control, before training this method.
initialization: alpha is exactly zero, so epoch zero is the frozen anchor
training_loss: primary loss of the mixed prediction plus 1.0 times the independent member's supervised loss plus 1e-4 times abs(alpha)
capacity_compute_match: The independent member has the same gradient-bearing parameter budget, seed offset, architecture family, optimizer, batches, and epoch budget as the fixed-ensemble control.
validation_gate: Beat the fixed independent ensemble in at least 7/12 external validation cells, have positive mean paired validation gain overall and within both task families, and beat the wide single T-PLE model in at least 7/12 cells.
test_role: Developmental because these external test metrics were already opened for the prior cascade before SafePLE was frozen.
